body.name: Changed-tail dependency-cycle handle
body.construction: Choose maximum matchings in the graphs \(\Gamma_i(K,O)\) and \(\Gamma_i(O,K)\), expose one supporting \(D_i\)-path for each matched pair, and form the tail-dependency multigraph whose arcs record which changed tails occur on those paths; use SCC contraction of this multigraph as the starting move for H-star.
